name: CuriaBots
description: Connects Orca to a CuriaBots agent: send work to Orca, with or without an issue, and follow what its agents do.

cover.alt: CuriaBots robot logo next to the title CuriaBots para Orca and a one-line description of the connector

settings.title: Service URL
settings.description: Base URL of the CuriaBots Orca service. Only change it to test against another server. Applies to links made after the change.

settings.title: Orca CLI path (optional)
settings.description: Absolute path of the Orca CLI, used only to reply to agents. Leave empty to detect it. On Linux the 'orca' in PATH may be the GNOME screen reader.

settings.title: Allow token without keyring (not recommended)
settings.description: Only if this computer has no OS key store (for example a server running 'orca serve' without a desktop): store the link token in the plugin's plain private storage instead of refusing to link. Anyone who can read your Orca data folder could use the token. A permanent warning is shown while it is in use.
